headword: {職務内容|しょくむないよう}

definitions.gloss: job duties; job description; scope of work
definitions.explanation: The specific tasks, responsibilities, and functions that make up a particular job or position.

examples.japanese: {職務内容|しょくむないよう}を{確認|かくにん}する。
{求人|きゅうじん}{広告|こうこく}に{職務内容|しょくむないよう}が{詳|くわ}しく{書|か}かれている。
examples.english: The job duties are described in detail in the job listing.

examples.japanese: {面接|めんせつ}で{具体的|ぐたいてき}な{職務内容|しょくむないよう}について{質問|しつもん}した。
examples.english: I asked about the specific job duties during the interview.

notes:
A compound of {職務|しょくむ} (duties, responsibilities) and {内容|ないよう} (contents, details). Used in formal business and human resources contexts to describe what a job involves. Commonly appears in job postings, employment contracts, and performance evaluations.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {職務内容|しょくむないよう}を{説明|せつめい}する: to explain job duties
- {職務内容|しょくむないよう}を{確認|かくにん}する: to confirm job duties
- {職務内容|しょくむないよう}の{変更|へんこう}: change in job duties
- {具体的|ぐたいてき}な{職務内容|しょくむないよう}: specific job duties

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {業務内容|ぎょうむないよう}: work content, business operations — broader; can refer to the work of a department or company, not just an individual
- {仕事内容|しごとないよう}: job content — less formal and more conversational
- {職務記述書|しょくむきじゅつしょ}: job description (document) — the formal written document itself
